newsitem.title: USA: Continental Air sees Q3 load factor, capacity up.
newsitem.headline: Continental Air sees Q3 load factor, capacity up.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said its third quarter bookings "look good," with load factors in Europe and Latin America showing the greatest gains.

The Houston-based airline said it expects its capacity to increase about nine percent in the third quarter, which will be mostly driven by international growth. During the second quarter ended June 30, Continental's capacity increased 8.8 percent.

Third quarter costs will increase about two percent over last year, up slightly from the one percent increase in costs during the second quarter, the company said in a conference call with reporters following its second quarter earnings report.
Continental's second quarter earnings dropped to $1.64 per diluted share from $2.04 per diluted share a year ago, but exceeded Wall Street expectations.
